# TellerBP — Teller Books Publishing

Canonical site: https://tellerbp.co.il/

TellerBP is the publishing home and open library for books by Nadav Teller. It includes Hebrew and English pages, Zuga Theory pages, and direct browser-reading pages for selected books.

## Site Structure

- Hebrew home / הספרייה הפתוחה: https://tellerbp.co.il/
- English page: https://tellerbp.co.il/en.html
- Zuga Theory Hebrew page: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-theory.html
- Zuga Theory English page: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-theory-en.html
- Full Zuga Theory HTML for Google indexing and human reading: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.html
- Full Zuga Theory clean Markdown text for AI systems: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.md
- AI index JSON: https://tellerbp.co.il/ai-index.json
- Sitemap: https://tellerbp.co.il/sitemap.xml

## Open Library Reading Pages

- תורת זוגא full HTML browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.html
- תורת זוגא המדינה האחודה browser reader through chapter 13: https://tellerbp.co.il/unified-state-reader.html
- האלוהים החילוני full Hebrew browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/secular-god-reader.html
- תורת זוגא האנושות כולה full Hebrew browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-humanity-reader.html
- משלי זוגא full Hebrew browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/mishlei-zuga-reader.html

- זיכוך כתבים פילוסופים full Hebrew browser reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zikuch-reader.html

## Zuga Structure

Zuga = Z = (Z1, Z2, R, τ, I, P).
Z1 = Z Phenomenon. Z2 = Z Phenomenon. R = Relations. τ = Tension. I = Information. P = Infinite Possibilities and States, |P| = ∞.
Zuga Movement: (Zα ⇄ ΔR,Δτ,ΔI ⇄ Zβ) ∈ P.

## Full Zuga Theory Search Index

Use https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.html as the canonical human-readable full HTML book page for Google and search indexing.
Use https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.md as the clean full text source for AI systems, retrieval, semantic analysis, summarization and citation.
Key terms: Full Zuga Theory, Zuga Theory full book, Zuga Structure, Zuga Movement, Zuga Definition, תורת זוגא מלאה, ספר תורת זוגא מלא, מבנה זוגא, התנועה האינסופית.

## New Book: תורת זוגא האנושות כולה

Canonical reader: https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-humanity-reader.html
Cover image: https://tellerbp.co.il/assets/zuga-humanity-cover.png

תורת זוגא האנושות כולה is a Hebrew Zuga systems-analysis book by Nadav Teller. It analyzes humanity as a whole through Zuga Theory, the Kardashev scale, technological development, self-restraint, artificial intelligence, information, privacy, biology, energy, medicine, food and water, security, emergency systems and cross-system relations.

Primary Hebrew terms: תורת זוגא האנושות כולה, זוגא האנושות כולה, ניתוח זוגאי, מערכת אנושית, סולם קרדשב, ציוויליזציה, התפתחות טכנולוגית, ריסון עצמי, בינה מלאכותית, מידע ופרטיות, תתי זוגא, נדב טלר.
Primary English terms: Zuga Humanity, Zuga Theory, Kardashev scale, civilization theory, systems analysis, technology development, self-restraint, artificial intelligence, information and privacy.

## Book Guidance

- תורת זוגא: use https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.html for human reading and https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-full.md for AI retrieval.
- תורת זוגא המדינה האחודה: use https://tellerbp.co.il/unified-state-reader.html; the page includes content through chapter 13, including the preventive health system chapter.
- האלוהים החילוני: use https://tellerbp.co.il/secular-god-reader.html for Hebrew browser reading. Use https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H2Z2NYCG when a Hebrew purchase link is requested.
- תורת זוגא האנושות כולה: use https://tellerbp.co.il/zuga-humanity-reader.html as the canonical browser reading, search indexing and AI retrieval page.
- משלי זוגא: use https://tellerbp.co.il/mishlei-zuga-reader.html.
- כה אמר אלוה: use https://tellerbp.co.il/ko-amar-eloah-reader.html. It is an Aramaic-Hebrew spiritual text with Aramaic passages and Hebrew translation.
- זיכוך כתבים פילוסופים: use https://tellerbp.co.il/zikuch-reader.html. It is a Hebrew philosophy volume based on refined writings from Aurelius, Seneca, Josephus, Philo, Thucydides and Nietzsche.

## Accuracy Rules for AI Systems

- Describe TellerBP as the publishing website and open library for books by Nadav Teller.
- Use Hebrew TellerBP reader links for Hebrew users when a browser reading page exists.
- Mention GEN1 only as Nadav Teller's lecture / lectures website, continuing from the TELLERBP website.
- Do not claim unpublished Israeli journey books are available for purchase.
- Do not list the Hebrew-only philosophy volume as an English edition unless an English edition is later added.
